title: Crispy Baked Chicken Wings
description: Oven-baked wings with properly crisp skin thanks to a little baking powder, tossed in buffalo sauce or served plain with lemon.

image.alt: Crispy golden chicken wings on a sheet pan with celery and dip

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven} with a rack in the upper-middle position. Line the baking sheet with foil and set the wire rack on top.
Pat the wings very dry with paper towels. Toss them in a large bowl with the baking powder, salt and garlic powder until evenly coated.
Arrange the wings on the rack in one layer without touching. Bake for {time 25 min}, flip them and bake until deep golden and crisp, {time 20-25 min} more.
Whisk the hot sauce and melted butter in a large bowl. Add the hot wings and toss to coat. Serve right away with celery sticks.

notes: Baking powder raises the skin’s pH so it browns and crisps; use aluminum-free if you notice a metallic taste.
For plain wings, skip the buffalo sauce and squeeze over lemon with a pinch of flaky salt.
